title: Remote Control returns "not yet available on your plan" for Max subscriber
body:
## Description

I am a Claude Max subscriber. When I run `claude remote-control`, I get the following error:

```
Error: Remote Control is not yet available on your plan.
```

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Run `claude remote-control` in terminal

## Steps Already Taken

- Confirmed I am on the Claude Max plan
- Re-authenticated via `claude /login`
- Claude Code CLI is up to date

## Expected Behavior

Remote Control should be available for Max plan users as documented.

## Environment

- **OS:** macOS (Darwin 25.2.0, Apple Silicon)
- **Claude Code CLI:** latest version
- **Plan:** Claude Max
author: ChristopherCC-Liu
